The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] conducted a '''raid''' on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]] prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who carried out the attack, only four survived, including [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Telsij/Legends|Telsij]].<ref name="CCG" />
